name: Direct eight-stud receiver platform
description: Twin keyed and cross-braced C-poles vault a pendulum body over the wall. A single printed PLA bearing cage supports the XL motor and backdrivable8.33:1spurdrive. Long pinned landing feet support the body; a lower mechanical stop finishes with poles folded forward below the1mgoalceiling. Timed full-power start and lower-power recovery.
